name: One Leg, Every Gait Number Wrong
_breaks: Every gait number the driver reads and then quietly does nothing useful with. `stride: 0` makes `Gait.advance` return 0, so the phase never moves and the foot stays planted while the body slides — the symptom is a creature skating and the cause is a field with no name on screen. `duty: 1.5` is clamped to 0.95 by `Gait.foot_cycle`, so it loads and means a foot that never leaves the ground. `lift: -0.05` is a foot that digs in. `speed: [6, 2]` is a range no speed is inside, so the gait never runs at all. `phases` has two entries for one leg, which `Locomotion.step` half-ignores and `Gait._mix_phases` refuses to blend. The second gait has no `name`, so nothing can report or match on it. `bounce` is not a gait field.
